name: Zuferian
source: Pathfinder #148: Fires of the Haunted City

items.name: Acid Flask (Greater) [Infused]
items.description:
Activate A Strike

This flask filled with corrosive acid deals 1 acid damage, 3d6 persistent acid damage, and 3 acid splash damage. You gain a +2 item bonus to attack rolls.

items.name: Frost Vial (Greater) [Infused]
items.description:
Activate 1 Strike

The liquid reagents in this vial rapidly absorb heat when exposed to air. A frost vial deals the listed cold damage and cold splash damage. On a hit, the target takes a status penalty to its Speeds until the end of its next turn. Many types of frost vial also grant an item bonus to attack rolls.

You gain a +2 item bonus to attack rolls, the bomb deals 3d6 cold damage and 3 cold splash damage, and the target takes a -10-foot penalty.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.Effect: Frost Vial]

items.name: Light Mace
items.description: A light mace has a short wooden or metal shaft ending with a dense metal head. Used much like a club, it delivers heavy bludgeoning blows, but with extra power derived from the head's metal ridges or spikes.

items.name: Thunderstone (Greater) [Infused]
items.description:
Activate 1 Strike

When this stone hits a creature or a hard surface, it explodes with a deafening bang. A thunderstone deals the listed sonic damage and sonic splash damage, and each creature within 10 feet of the space in which the stone exploded must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:28|name:Greater Thunderstone|showDC:all] saving throw with the listed DC or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Deafened] until the end of its next turn. Many types of thunderstone grant an item bonus to attack rolls.

You gain a +2 item bonus to attack rolls. The bomb deals 3d4 sonic damage and 3 sonic splash damage, and the DC is 28.

items.name: Alchemist's Fire (Greater) [Infused]
items.description:
Activate A Strike

Alchemist's fire is a combination of volatile liquids that ignite when exposed to air. Alchemist's fire deals 3d8 fire damage, 3 persistent fire damage, and 3 fire splash damage. You gain a +2 item bonus to attack rolls.

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description: A mix of flexible and molded boiled leather, a suit of this type of armor provides some protection with maximum flexibility.

items.name: Alchemist Goggles (Greater)
items.description:
These brass goggles are engraved with flame patterns and have thick, heavy lenses.

While worn, they give you a +2 item bonus to Crafting checks to Craft alchemical items and a +2 item bonus to attack rolls with alchemical bombs.

You can also ignore lesser cover when making Strikes with alchemical bombs.

items.name: Formula Book
items.description: A formula book holds the formulas necessary to make items other than the common equipment from this chapter; alchemists typically get one for free. Each formula book can hold the formulas for up to 100 different items. Formulas can also appear on parchment sheets, tablets, and almost any other medium; there's no need for you to copy them into a specific book as long as you can keep them on hand to reference them.

items.name: Alchemist's Tools
items.description: This mobile collection of vials and chemicals can be used for simple alchemical tasks.

generalAbilities.name: Infused Items
generalAbilities.description: Zuferian's items listed as infused last for 24 hours, or until her next daily preparations.

offensiveAbilities.name: Alchemical Formulas
offensiveAbilities.description:

offensiveAbilities.name: Expanded Splash
offensiveAbilities.description: Zuferian's bombs that have the splash trait deal 8 extra splash damage, and splash to 10 feet.

offensiveAbilities.name: Quick Alchemy
offensiveAbilities.description: Zuferian creates a single alchemical item from her formula book. This item has the infused trait, but it remains potent only until the start of her next turn. With her typical preparations, she can use this ability 7 times per day.

offensiveAbilities.name: Quick Bomber
offensiveAbilities.description: Zuferian Interacts to draw a bomb, then Strikes with it.

offensiveAbilities.name: True Debilitating Bomb
offensiveAbilities.description:
When Zuferian uses Debilitating Bomb, add the following to the list of effects Zuferian can choose from:

  • Enfeebled 2
  • Stupefied 2
  • a -15-foot status penalty to Speeds.

If Zuferian instead applies one of the effects listed in Debilitating Bomb, the target avoids the effect only if the result of its saving throw is a critical success.

offensiveAbilities.name: Uncanny Bombs
offensiveAbilities.description: When Zuferian throws an alchemical item with the bomb trait, its range increment increases to 60 feet, Zuferian reduces any circumstance bonus to the target's AC from cover by 1, and Zuferian automatically succeeds at the flat check when targeting a concealed creature.
